get.description: Get a list of an account's available templates.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

parameters.name: exclude_fields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Used for [pagination](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/methods-parameters/#pagination), this is the number of records from a collection to skip. Default value is 0.

parameters.name: created_by
parameters.description: The Mailchimp account user who created the template.

parameters.name: since_date_created
parameters.description: Restrict the response to templates created after the set date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: before_date_created
parameters.description: Restrict the response to templates created before the set date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Limit results based on template type.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Limit results based on category.

parameters.name: folder_id
parameters.description: The unique folder id.

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description: Returns user templates sorted by the specified field.

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description: Limit results based on how the template's content is put together. Only templates of type `user` can be filtered by `content_type`. If you want to retrieve saved templates created with the legacy email editor, then filter `content_type` to `template`. If you'd rather pull your saved templates for the new editor, filter to `multichannel`. For code your own templates, filter to `html`.

parameters.name: sort_dir
parameters.description: Determines the order direction for sorted results.

responsive.title: Responsive
responsive.description: Whether the template contains media queries to make it responsive.

category.title: Template Category
category.description: If available, the category the template is listed in.

date_created.title: Date Created
date_created.description: The date and time the template was created in ISO 8601 format.

date_edited.title: Date Edited
date_edited.description: The date and time the template was edited in ISO 8601 format.

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: The login name for template's creator.

edited_by.title: Edited By
edited_by.description: The login name who last edited the template.

active.title: Active

folder_id.title: Folder ID
folder_id.description: The id of the folder the template is currently in.

thumbnail.title: Template Thumbnail
thumbnail.description: If available, the URL for a thumbnail of the template.

content_type.description: How the template's content is put together.

default.description: An error generated by the Mailchimp API.

schema.title: Problem Detail Document
schema.description: An error generated by the Mailchimp API. Conforms to IETF draft 'draft-nottingham-http-problem-06'.

type.title: Problem Type
type.description: An absolute URI that identifies the problem type. When dereferenced, it should provide human-readable documentation for the problem type.

title.title: Error Title
title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. It shouldn't change based on the occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization.

status.title: HTTP Status Code
status.description: The HTTP status code (RFC2616, Section 6) generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

detail.title: Error Message
detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem. [Learn more about errors](/developer/guides/get-started-with-mailchimp-api-3/#Errors).
detail.example: The requested resource could not be found.

instance.title: Instance ID
instance.description: A string that identifies this specific occurrence of the problem. Please provide this ID when contacting support.

get.description: Get the sections that you can edit in a template, including each section's default content.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

parameters.name: exclude_fields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: The unique id for the template.
